title: Window Cleaning Preventive Maintenance Checklist Form
subtitle: Control access setup, exclusion, glass cleaning, equipment control, inspection, and release through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete window cleaning preventive maintenance checklist for windows, frames, anchors, ladders, lifts, ropes, tools, and exclusion zones. It connects work plan, access method, anchors, products, and site approval to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a trained window-cleaning technician must perform scheduled window cleaning maintenance against an identified plan while preserving readings, defects, deferrals, verification, and the next due event.

sections.title: Window Cleaning measurements and post-maintenance verification
sections.guidance: Use repeatable observations to show the maintained scope reached the stated condition.

blocks.label: Measurement and verification log
blocks.guidance: Applicable measurement concepts include: Elevation, drop, window count, or serviced area, Wind, temperature, precipitation, or surface condition, Anchor, access, ladder, lift, or equipment identifier, Rope, harness, connector, or inspection status, Water, product, or solution concentration, Start, suspension, restart, and completion time.

blocks.label: Post-maintenance condition and function checks
items: All authorized windows are cleaned or explicitly excluded
Glass, frame, tint, coating, seal, and surrounding property are undamaged
No unacceptable streak, residue, runoff, debris, or loose item remains
Anchors, roof access, doors, screens, and building controls are restored
Ladders, lifts, ropes, harnesses, connectors, tools, and keys are reconciled
Exclusion zones remain until overhead exposure is removed
Glass or facade defects and inaccessible areas are documented
Customer received limitations, damage observations, and next-service plan

sections.title: Window Cleaning defect containment and corrective-action routing
sections.guidance: A preventive checklist does not release an unsafe, unverified, or out-of-scope condition.

blocks.label: Window Cleaning exception and stop-work indicators
items: Anchor, tieback, davit, roof, parapet, or building information unavailable
Required fall protection, rescue, communication, or competent review unavailable
Ladder, lift, scaffold, rope, harness, connector, or tool fails inspection
Wind, storm, lightning, ice, heat, visibility, or wet-surface condition unsafe
Electrical conductor, fragile roof, skylight, edge, or facade hazard uncontrolled
Pedestrian, occupant, vehicle, doorway, or lower-level exclusion cannot be maintained
Glass is cracked, loose, heat-stressed, coated, tinted, or incompatible with the method
Falling-object, water, hose, chemical, or equipment movement cannot be controlled
Facade access requires a method or height beyond the approved plan
Technician reports fatigue, medical, communication, or rescue-readiness concern
blocks.guidance: Select the observed condition; do not use a generic exception when the actual trigger is known.

sections.title: Window Cleaning preventive maintenance checklist closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This window cleaning preventive maintenance checklist is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when anchorage, access equipment, fall protection, rescue, weather, electrical, public exclusion, facade, glass, or drop-zone condition is uncertain. A access and fall-protection supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
